tokens.name: void-000
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: window backdrop, the space behind every panel.

tokens.name: void-100
tokens.usage: Panel and window body surface. Default ground for settings forms.

tokens.name: void-200
tokens.usage: Raised fill: inputs, selects, active tab, table header rows.

tokens.name: void-300
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers between setting rows. Decorative only, never a control border.

tokens.name: void-400
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons). 3:1 against void-100.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and labels on void-000/100/200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Setting hints, captions, placeholder text. 4.5:1+ on void-000/100/200.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Text and icons on blood-500 and cobalt-500 fills, in both themes.

tokens.name: blood-500
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (Save, Confirm), the brand red. Text on it: bone.

tokens.name: blood-600
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of blood-500.

tokens.name: blood-text
tokens.usage: Red as text: errors, destructive links, the sigil accent in headings. 4.5:1+ on void-000/100/200.

tokens.name: blood-wash
tokens.usage: Background of error / destructive notices, under blood-text and ink.

tokens.name: cobalt-500
tokens.usage: Secondary brand fill: selected tab underline, info notices, toggles on. Text on it: bone.

tokens.name: cobalt-600
tokens.usage: Hover state of cobalt-500.

tokens.name: cobalt-text
tokens.usage: Blue as text: links, info notice titles, active tab label.

tokens.name: cobalt-wash
tokens.usage: Background of info notices.

tokens.name: ward
tokens.usage: Focus ring on every focusable control (2px outline, 2px offset). 3:1+ on all voids.

tokens.name: ichor
tokens.usage: Warning only (requires reload, deprecated setting). Text on void-000/100; small doses.

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: Success only (saved, valid). Text on void-000/100; small doses.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Module splash and journal titles. Bebas Neue is caps-only, weight 400.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Window titles, settings page headers. Always uppercase (Bebas has caps only).

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Section headings inside a settings form.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A escuridão responde a quem a chama.

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: Setting hints under a field, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, badges, column headers. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; hint below a field.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control inner padding (vertical), gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control inner padding (horizontal), setting row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Window body padding, gap between setting rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a settings form.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Splash and empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Windows, panels, tabs: monoliths have no soft edges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Toggle track and knob only.

tokens.name: shadow-pit
tokens.usage: Inputs and selects: carved into the stone.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Floating windows and dialogs.
